app.title: NeuroStation MVP1.0.3 · EEG workstation
app.active_task: A capture task is active and owns the device.
home.subtitle: Devices, signals and capture apps in one workspace.
device.title: Device connection
device.mapping_note: Configure channel positions for the actual electrode placement.
device.serial_note: The serial port is scanned automatically. Close OpenBCI GUI if it owns the dongle.
device.preflight_idle: Hardware preflight has not run. It opens Cyton and captures a short sample.
device.preflight_warning_timestamps: Timestamps: {count} abnormal intervals ({ratio}%), maximum interval {max_ms} ms.
device.preflight_warning_channels: Channels {channels}: most samples are flat or near saturation.
device.preflight_packet_sequence_ok: Packet sequence is continuous; no lost samples detected. Timestamp gaps reflect host delivery jitter.
device.preflight_packet_loss: Packet sequence: {lost} samples lost, {mismatch} sequence mismatches, {duplicate} duplicates.
device.mapping_fixed: Board inputs are fixed as CH1–CH8 (N1P–N8P); select the actual electrode placement in the per-channel calibration below.
device.calibration_note: Select the actual electrode placement and test each channel one at a time. Save is enabled only after all 8 channels pass, the auxiliary electrode positions are filled, and the protocol and display timing are acknowledged.
device.calibration_position_placeholder: Enter or select the actual position
device.calibration_running: Testing CH{channel}; keep the electrodes and participant still…
device.protocol_reviewed: I reviewed the protocol, 60 Hz display refresh, and optical / Marker timing for formal use
device.save_formal_prompt: This becomes the default channel configuration for formal experiments and stops using the draft map. Save it now?
device.calibration_ready: Formal configuration is active; acquisition will no longer require draft override after reopening the task.
device.calibration_notes: Tested per channel from the device calibration page and confirmed by the operator.
apps.subtitle: Open a capture task just like an app.
apps.flow: SSVEP: setup → hardware preflight → full-screen stimulus → dataset.
result.legacy_readonly: Legacy simulated record · read-only, not real EEG
result.legacy_notice: This is a demo, visual-preview, or Synthetic record from an older version. It is not treated as Cyton hardware acquisition and must not be used as formal experimental EEG.
dataset_summary.title: Dataset summary
dataset_summary.readonly: Read-only summary. Original OpenBCI files were not modified, and no participant or experiment metadata was invented.
dataset_summary.legacy: Legacy simulated record (read-only; not a real acquisition)
dataset_summary.data_preview_note: Read-only first 100 rows. The complete raw file is not loaded or modified. Headers show localized meanings and retain raw field names in parentheses; choose another raw shard to inspect it.
ssvep.subtitle: Steady-state visual evoked potentials · Four-target screen stimulation
ssvep.workflow_steps: Step 1 participant and session  →  Step 2 protocol and stimulus  →  Step 3 preflight and start
ssvep.description: Follow each target cue while recording eight EEG channels and stimulus events. Visit targets in sequence for each repetition.
ssvep.safety: Photosensitivity notice: real Cyton acquisition presents full-screen visual stimuli and may cause discomfort. People with photosensitive epilepsy or related history should not participate. Press Esc or Q immediately if uncomfortable.
ssvep.defaults: Parameters are ready: SSVEP · 5 s stimulus · 3 s rest · 3 repetitions per target · 60 Hz. Select an acquisition user, connect Cyton, and complete hardware preflight before starting.
field.name: Dataset name
field.port_auto: AUTO scans ports at start and tries each one; an explicit COM/device path is also supported.
field.port_detected: Detected ports: {ports}; selected {selected}. Start will verify the Cyton link again.
field.port_none: No serial port detected yet. Connect the USB dongle and scan again, or start for diagnostics.
ssvep.screen_mapping: Automatic display mapping: left eye → {left}; right eye → {right}; only the selected eye display flickers and the other display stays black.
ssvep.screen_mapping_missing: Display mapping unavailable: formal left/right acquisition requires at least two displays.
ssvep.screen_mapping_horizontal_missing: Display mapping unavailable: the displays have no distinct horizontal positions. Arrange them side by side and retry.
ssvep.dataset_name_pending: Choose an eye side to append “_左眼” or “_右眼” automatically.
field.channel_auto: Use the default CH1–CH8 board channel mapping
field.channel_manual: Advanced: specify a channel configuration JSON
field.channel_manual_placeholder: Enable Advanced to choose JSON; the default needs no file
ssvep.refresh_note: 60 Hz is illustrative. Production acquisition must measure refresh timing and validate frame schedules.
ssvep.formula: Total = 5-second preparation + stimuli + inter-trial rests. No rest after the last trial.
ssvep.countdown_note: Start begins a 5-second countdown. Acquisition always runs in real time.
ssvep.acknowledge: I have read the photosensitivity notice and can abort with Esc / Q
ssvep.allow_draft: Technical validation only: allow draft protocol or incomplete channel map
ssvep.production: Production task uses full-screen stimuli. This UI prototype remains static.
task.prepare_note: Get comfortable and prepare to look at the cued target.
task.capture.cyton: OpenBCI Cyton capture · 8 CH / 250 Hz · Raw data persisted
task.waveform_note: Shows samples already flushed by the acquisition worker. Countdown and empty states are not padded with zeros; display filtering never changes the raw file.
task.realtime: Real-time execution · Full-screen stimulus · Planned recording: {duration}
task.cancelled: Task cancelled. If the acquisition worker had started, partial data is preserved in the dataset directory.
result.title: Capture task completed
result.error_title: Capture task ended with an error
result.cyton_saved: Complete · OpenBCI Cyton raw data saved
result.aborted_saved: Aborted · Partial acquisition data safely saved
result.error_saved: Error · Recoverable data and diagnostics saved
result.imported_notice: This record was imported from OpenBCI files. The original files were not modified and no experiment events were invented.
result.recorded_notice: The acquisition worker saved real Cyton board data, events, protocol, frame timing, session metadata, and a verification manifest.
result.denoising.title: Offline denoising research results
result.denoising.note: Derived results are read-only; the raw EEG file was not modified. Line-noise ratio is relative to neighboring-band power.
result.denoising.parameters_value: Bandpass {bandpass} · order {order} · notches {line_noise} · Q={quality} · short-gap interpolation ≤ {max_gap} s
result.path_written: Absolute path containing saved session metadata
datasets.subtitle: Sessions and app results are collected in the workstation.
datasets.trash_subtitle: Only datasets moved to the recycle bin appear here. Restoring returns them to Datasets; removing deletes them permanently.
datasets.search_placeholder: Filter by name, participant or user ID
datasets.empty: No datasets yet. Complete a real Cyton acquisition or import an OpenBCI recording to see it here.
datasets.delete_prompt: Move dataset "{name}" to the recycle bin? Its files can still be restored from there.
datasets.purge_prompt: Permanently delete dataset "{name}" and all of its files? This cannot be undone.
users.subtitle: Register acquisition users and maintain traceable user links. Medical information stays in the local profile registry.
users.delete_prompt: Delete user {user_id} · {name}? Choose how to handle linked data.
users.delete_keep_data: Move profile to trash; keep data
users.delete_move_data: Move profile and data to trash
users.purge_prompt: Permanently delete {name} and linked data already in the recycle bin. This cannot be undone. Continue?
users.demo_protected: The demo user is protected and cannot be deleted.
users.search_placeholder: Filter by user ID or name
openbci.subtitle: Chinese source-rebuild workspace · Planned integration
openbci.notice: OpenBCI GUI is for viewing and analysis. NeuroStation owns the Cyton serial connection, real acquisition, and session persistence.
openbci.tools: Time series / FFT / channel settings / signal quality
openbci.started: OpenBCI GUI started with process ID {pid}.
integration.subtitle: Acquisition tools, experiments and analysis environments.
integration.brainflow: BrainFlow · Production gateway planned; not imported by this UI
integration.openbci: OpenBCI GUI · Chinese source rebuild planned
integration.analysis: MNE / EEGLAB / MATLAB · Standard-file export planned
diagnostics.subtitle: Review runtime checks, device discovery and recent errors; logs exclude raw EEG and medical fields.
diagnostics.no_events: No events yet. Errors, task starts, preflight and import actions are recorded here.
diagnostics.detail.resources_missing: One or more resource files are missing.
diagnostics.detail.configuration_ready: Configuration is ready for the formal workflow.
diagnostics.detail.configuration_warning: Configuration has {count} draft or validation warnings.
diagnostics.detail.dependencies_missing: At least one core dependency is unavailable.
diagnostics.detail.save_failed: The save directory does not exist or is not writable.
diagnostics.detail.serial_empty: No serial endpoints found; connect the USB dongle and run hardware preflight again.
validation.identity: Enter a participant ID and dataset name.
validation.dataset_trash_exists: A dataset directory with this ID already exists in the recycle bin.
validation.dataset_restore_path: The dataset has no original path and cannot be restored.
validation.dataset_restore_conflict: The original dataset directory already exists, so the dataset cannot be restored.
validation.dataset_path: The dataset path is outside the managed directory.
validation.user_age: Age must be an integer from 0 to 150.
validation.user_medical: Choose at least one medical-history option.
validation.user_medical_none: None cannot be selected with another condition.
validation.user_medical_other: Add notes when Other is selected.
validation.user_id_duplicate: That user ID already exists or is still in the recycle bin.
validation.user_not_found: The acquisition user does not exist or is in the recycle bin.
validation.user_demo: The demo user is only for workflow demos and cannot be used for formal acquisition.
validation.parameters: Use stimulus 1–30 s, rest 0–30 s, and repetitions 1–10.
validation.path: Choose an absolute directory path on this computer.
validation.refresh: The current protocol requires a 60 Hz screen.
validation.speed: Real acquisition only supports 1× real time.
validation.production_speed: Cyton acquisition must run at 1× real time.
validation.real_hardware_only: This version only allows real OpenBCI Cyton hardware acquisition.
validation.port: Use AUTO to scan ports, or enter a path such as COM5 or /dev/cu.usbserial-*.
validation.screen: Choose a valid stimulus screen index.
validation.eye_side: Choose left or right eye before starting acquisition.
validation.screens: Left/right eye acquisition requires at least two available displays.
validation.flicker_ack: Acknowledge the photosensitivity notice before full-screen flashing.
validation.channel_path: The channel configuration must be an absolute path.
validation.channel_missing: The Cyton channel configuration file does not exist. Create and review the final channel map.
validation.calibration_config: The channel calibration payload is invalid.
validation.calibration_missing: Enter an actual electrode position for all 8 channels; unspecified is not allowed.
validation.calibration_duplicate: Actual electrode positions must be unique across all 8 channels.
validation.calibration_test_required: Test all 8 channels one at a time and make sure each result is passed.
validation.calibration_aux_missing: Enter the actual wired positions for reference (SRB), BIAS, and ground (AGND).
validation.calibration_protocol_ack: Acknowledge review of the protocol, display refresh rate, and optical / Marker timing.
validation.calibration_validation: The formal channel configuration failed validation. Check channel order, positions, and hardware parameters.
validation.calibration_result: The channel test returned no valid result.
validation.hardware_draft: The protocol or channel map is still draft/incomplete. Formal Cyton acquisition is blocked; enable draft configuration only for technical validation.
validation.hardware_config: The formal Cyton configuration failed validation. Check the protocol, channel map, sampling rate, and channel count.
validation.preflight_failed: Hardware preflight failed, so Cyton acquisition was blocked. Check the device, electrodes, and serial port.
validation.preflight_warning_blocked: {port} completed the Cyton handshake, but quality warnings blocked formal acquisition: {detail}
validation.preflight_warning_started: {port} completed the Cyton handshake; quality warnings were detected, but acquisition continues following OpenBCI GUI behavior. The warning will be retained with the session: {detail}
validation.preflight_degraded_blocked: Data quality on {port} is degraded, so acquisition is paused for review. Check packet sequence, timestamps, and channel connections: {detail}
validation.preflight_warning_allowed: {port} completed the Cyton handshake with quality warnings. Technical validation will continue and retain the preflight warning: {detail}
validation.worker_start: The acquisition worker could not be started.
validation.worker_failed: The acquisition worker exited unexpectedly. Check the device, port, channel map, and log.
validation.busy: Stop or cancel the active task before starting another one.
validation.manual_marker: Manual markers require an active manual recording.
validation.manual_stop: There is no active manual recording to stop.
validation.openbci_unavailable: OpenBCI GUI has not been built or configured. Build the locked source first.
error.title: Unable to perform action
